Market today: Tech sentiment is strong, driven by massive projected AI spending and a surging Taiwan tech market. Geopolitical oil tensions are a background risk, but tech seems to be pushing through.

Your holdings: SOXL (-44.23%) and SPAL (-30.62%) are still deep in the red. These leveraged ETFs decay, and trading on margin amplifies losses, so they need close attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market's reaction to any escalation in oil tensions, but primarily focus on continued strength in the chip sector.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged losers while riding the tech/chip momentum.
plays: SOXL: Review your stop at 200 or consider trimming. This leveraged ETF is a major drag and risk, especially on margin.
SPAL: Re-evaluate your stop at 21.38 or trim. Its leveraged nature amplifies losses on margin.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
